INDOMITABLESPIRE2-CARRIER_AIRCRAFT.title: Carrier Aircraft
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-CARRIER_AIRCRAFT.descr: A special type of card that triggers effects applied to Carrier Aircraft. Has Durability and is immune to Thorns.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-STRIKE_FIGHTER.title: Strike Fighter
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-STRIKE_FIGHTER.descrip: A Carrier Aircraft classified as a Strike Fighter, triggering related effects. Usually provides [gold]Block[/gold] or tactical effects.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-TORPEDO_BOMBER.title: Torpedo Bomber
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-TORPEDO_BOMBER.descrip: A Carrier Aircraft classified as a Torpedo Bomber, triggering related effects. May apply [blue]Flooded[/blue] or [gold]Armor Break[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-DIVE_BOMBER.title: Dive Bomber
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-DIVE_BOMBER.descriptio: A Carrier Aircraft classified as a Dive Bomber, triggering related effects. Usually bypasses some of the enemy's defense mechanisms.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-LEVEL_BOMBER.title: Level Bomber
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-LEVEL_BOMBER.descripti: A Carrier Aircraft classified as a Level Bomber, triggering related effects. Usually features [gold]AoE Damage[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-DURABILITY.title: Durability
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-DURABILITY.description: Loses durability based on the target's attack damage when attacking an enemy intending to attack. [gold]Exhaust[/gold] when durability reaches zero.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-FORMATION.title: Formation
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-FORMATION.description: When played, put a random card with the same name that does not cost 0 Energy from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] or [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-COMMISSION.title: Commission
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-COMMISSION.description: Unplayable until completed. When played, both you and the player who gave it to you gain rewards.
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ELEGANCE.title: Elegance
INDOMITABLESPIRE2-ELEGANCE.description: If you take no unblocked damage in a turn, triggers its effect at the start of your next turn.
